ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the above food web diagram, if all the algae dies then water flea population will
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram shows a producer box labeled “algae and macrophytes” near the bottom left. A blue arrow goes upward from “algae and macrophytes” to the organism labeled “water flea.” Reasoning: In a food web, an arrow from a food source to an organism means the organism eats or depends on that source. Since the water flea depends on algae/macrophytes for food, if all the algae dies, the water flea loses an important food source, so its population will decrease.
